title: Towards Trustworthy and Aligned Machine Learning: A Data-centric Survey with Causality Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying literature that evaluates gender bias through counterfactual data augmentation (e.g., gender word substitution), bias-inducing prompts, and analyzing representation bias/stereotypes in text generated by large language models.

Reviewing studies that measure outcome discrimination and quality disparity across different racial and ethnic groups, such as evaluating performance degradation in face recognition models for minority demographic groups.
Reviewing literature that probes large language models to identify and quantify negative stereotypes and persistent representation biases against specific religious groups (e.g., anti-Muslim bias).
